answer: Bind each identity to a distinct residential address. Each epoch the lotus network mails a one-time code to every registered address; a verifier accepts only if the code returns signed and the address appears once in a public log. Extra identities need extra addresses with a responding occupant, costing C per address per period. With per-identity reward capped at R, n sybils earn n(R-C), so the attacker's delta is positive only while R>C. Nodes mirror the log so duplicate addresses are visible; a colluding postal carrier remains the weakness.
